collections.title: Pour-over brewing
collections.descriptionHtml: Drippers, filters and kettles for manual brewing.

pages.title: About Fernhill
pages.body: We are a small roastery and brewing-gear shop in Bristol. We roast twice a week.

pages.title: Shipping and returns
pages.body: UK orders ship within two working days.

products.title: Ceramic Cone Dripper, size 02
products.descriptionHtml:
Elevate your mornings with our most-loved dripper!

Made from glazed porcelain fired in Arita, Japan. Fits size 02 cone filters and brews 1 to 4 cups. Single large outlet hole; spiral ribs on the inner wall leave room for air to escape. Weight 380 g. Dishwasher safe.

products.title: Flat-Bottom Dripper, stainless steel
products.descriptionHtml: Brushed 18/8 stainless steel body with three small holes in a flat bed, which slows the drawdown and gives an even extraction. Takes 185-size wave filters. Brews 1 to 2 cups (up to 500 ml). Double wall keeps the slurry warmer than a single-wall dripper. 210 g.

products.title: Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle 900 ml
products.descriptionHtml:
The kettle baristas reach for.

  • Capacity 900 ml, recommended fill 600 ml
  • Spout opening 8 mm for a thin, controllable stream
  • Built-in thermometer reading 40–100 °C
  • Stainless steel, works on gas, electric and induction hobs

products.title: Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold
products.descriptionHtml:
Set the temperature in 1 °C steps from 60 to 100 °C and the base holds it for 60 minutes. 800 ml capacity. 1200 W heating element. UK plug. Base cable 75 cm.

Perfect for coffee lovers who demand the very best.

images.altText: Electric gooseneck kettle on its base

products.title: Hand Grinder, conical steel burrs
products.descriptionHtml: 38 mm hardened stainless steel conical burrs. External click adjustment with 30 settings, from espresso to French press. Holds 25 g of beans. Aluminium body, 520 g. Grinds a 15 g dose for pour-over in about 40 seconds.

products.title: Electric Flat-Burr Grinder
products.descriptionHtml: 64 mm flat steel burrs, stepless adjustment. Single-dose design: retention under 0.1 g. 250 W motor at 1,400 rpm. Bellows on top to puff out remaining grounds. Height 38 cm.

products.title: French Press 1 litre
products.descriptionHtml: Borosilicate glass beaker in a stainless steel frame. 1 litre, about 4 mugs. Four-layer mesh filter. All parts come apart for cleaning; the beaker is replaceable.

products.title: Cold Brew Jar 1.5 litre
products.descriptionHtml: Glass jar with a fine stainless steel filter basket that holds up to 150 g of coarse ground coffee. Makes 1.5 litres of concentrate. Airtight lid; fits in a fridge door. Recommended steep 12 to 18 hours in the fridge.

products.title: Ethiopia Guji, natural process
products.descriptionHtml: Grown at 1,900–2,100 m in the Guji zone by smallholders delivering to the Hambela washing station. Heirloom varieties. Natural process, dried on raised beds for 21 days. Light roast. Tasting notes: blueberry, dark chocolate, jasmine.

products.title: Colombia Huila, washed
products.descriptionHtml: From the Pitalito municipality in Huila, 1,600–1,800 m. Caturra and Castillo varieties. Fully washed, fermented 36 hours. Medium roast, suited to both filter and espresso. Tasting notes: red apple, caramel, milk chocolate.

products.title: Paper Filters, size 02 (100 pack)
products.descriptionHtml: 100 unbleached cone filters for size 02 drippers. Oxygen-whitened alternative available. Rinse with hot water before brewing to remove paper taste.

products.title: Brew Scale with Timer
products.descriptionHtml: Weighs up to 2 kg in 0.1 g steps. Built-in timer starts automatically when the first drops land. USB-C rechargeable battery, about 30 hours per charge. Silicone pad protects against heat. 13 × 13 × 2.5 cm.
